title: One Roadmap, Four Very Different Conversations
description:
The same roadmap has to be told differently to every audience, or you promise something you never meant to. Engineering and design need enough specificity to plan capacity a quarter or two out, but no firm commitments on "Later" items. Sales need honest themes, never ship dates on unbuilt features. Leadership need the tie to company OKRs, and public customers get quarters, never exact dates. A roadmap is a communication tool, not a contract.

Source lesson:
- https://sigilipelli.github.io/product-manager-mastery-path/level-1/08-roadmapping-basics/

#Shorts

beats.narration: One roadmap. Four completely different conversations. Tell it the same way to everyone, and you break a promise you never meant to make.
Engineering and design need enough specificity to plan capacity a quarter or two out. What they don't get: firm commitments on anything in your Later column.

display.heading: Engineering / design
display.subheading: Specificity to plan capacity 1-2 quarters out -- not firm commitments on "Later" items

beats.narration: Sales need themes that set customer expectations honestly. Never give them a ship date on an unbuilt feature. That's a promise sales can't keep.

display.heading: Sales
display.subheading: Themes that set expectations honestly -- never specific ship dates on unbuilt features

beats.narration: Leadership need how the roadmap ties to company goals and OKRs, not just a feature list with no why. Public customers get quarters or later this year, never a date.

display.heading: Leadership / customers
display.subheading: Leadership: how it ties to OKRs, not a feature list with no "why". Customers: directional confidence, not a contract

beats.narration: A roadmap is a communication tool, not a contract. Every audience will try to hold you to the exact wording. So say your confidence level out loud, every time.

display.heading: A roadmap is a communication tool, not a contract
display.subheading: State the confidence level explicitly every time you share it
